chunks: Aḥmad ibn ʿAbdūn informed us of it, from ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad ibn al-Zubayr, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Faḍḍāl, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Najrān, from Ḥammād ibn ʿĪsā, from Ḥarīz, from Zurārah and Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
The menstruating woman and the person in janabah may recite something. He said: Yes, whatever they wish, except the sajdah, and they may remember Allah in every state.

key_terms.اللَّهَ: Allah, the One remembered in all states
key_terms.الْجُنُبُ: a person in a state of janabah requiring ghusl
key_terms.يَذْكُرَانِ: they both remember Allah through dhikr

ai.seo_question: Can a menstruating woman or a person in janabah recite the Qur'an and perform dhikr?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning Qur'an recitation for the menstruating woman and the person in janabah. It permits them to recite as much as they wish except the verse of sajdah, and affirms that dhikr of Allah is allowed in every condition.
